sections.text: We can help Tower Hamlets residents navigate the benefits system and apply for a range of benefits to help you maximise your income and get your full benefit entitlement.
You may be eligible for payments such as:

• Personal Independence Payments (PIP) • Attendance Allowance (AA) • Disability Living Allowance for disabled children (DLA) • Pension Credit • Council Tax Reduction • Carers Allowance • Universal Credit.
For help with benefit applications, please call 0800 808 5701 or email advice@toynbeehall.org.uk
PLEASE NOTE: This service is for Tower Hamlets residents ONLY.
Do you need help with something else? Please complete our form and find out how we can help.
